verdict.rationale: The DGX B200 is a physical system that customers run in their own data centers. First-party docs cover on-prem operation: redundant PSUs, BMC management with Redfish/IPMI/KVM, node and cluster health monitoring, the Docker and NVIDIA Container Toolkit stack, and support for physically moving the system. Community posts describe operators virtualizing HGX B200 GPUs on their own infrastructure with Fabric Manager and VFIO passthrough. Missing for 10: explicit installation/site-preparation documentation in the pack, and independent hands-on reports of a full self-hosted DGX B200 deployment beyond the virtualization discussion.
